Name: NPCHat
Author: secsky3
Description:
[center][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=6][b]SpouseHat[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Equip Hats on Spouses & Villagers with In-Game Real-Time Offset Tuning[/i][/size]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/secsky3][img]https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg[/img][/url]
[/color][/center]


[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]✨ Overview[/b][/size]
In vanilla Stardew Valley, only horses, pets, and children can wear hats—spouses and villagers cannot.
[b]SpouseHat[/b] allows you to put any hat on your spouse and every village NPC!

Equipped with an [b]in-game real-time tuning side panel[/b], you can adjust hat positions for each facing direction on the fly without repeatedly digging through config menus.

[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]🌟 Key Features[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]🎩 Hats for Everyone[/b]: Equip hats on any spouse or town NPC via a dedicated 1-slot inventory UI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]🛠️ Real-Time Offset Side Panel[/b]: Fine-tune hat positions live while seeing the NPC react behind the menu.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]🔄 4-Directional Independent Offsets[/b]: Fully supports asymmetrical sprites with independent Down, Up, Right, and Left offset tabs.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]🔀 Individual vs. Category Scope[/b]: Toggle between setting an override for a single specific NPC ([b]Individual[/b]) or applying changes across all NPCs sharing the same body type ([b]Category[/b]: Child, Female, Male).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]🔄 NPC Turn Button[/b]: Rotate the NPC 90° directly inside the menu to inspect hat placement from all angles instantly.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]🛡️ 100% Safe & Clean[/b]: Uses zero Harmony patches. Operates strictly through SMAPI rendering and vanilla global inventories to eliminate mod conflicts and save corruption risks.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]⚙️ GMCM Support[/b]: All base category offsets and hotkeys can also be configured via Generic Mod Config Menu.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]🎮 Controls & Usage[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list=1]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stand near any villager or spouse (within 1.5 tiles / 96px).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Press [b]H[/b] (default hotkey, configurable) to open the hat inventory and offset tuning side panel.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place any valid hat into the slot (or take it back to unequip).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Use the side panel to adjust positions:
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Individual / Category Toggle[/b]: Choose whether adjustments apply only to this NPC or to all villagers of the same category.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Direction Tabs (Down / Up / Right / Left)[/b]: Select a direction to tune; the NPC immediately turns to match.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Turn Button[/b]: Cycles through NPC directions.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]X / Y Buttons ([-5], [-1], [+1], [+5])[/b]: Instantly shifts the hat position.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Reset Button[/b]: Reverts custom offsets back to category defaults.[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]📥 Requirements & Installation[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list=1]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (v4.0.0 or higher, Stardew Valley 1.6+).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] for in-game configuration.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and extract the [b]SpouseHat[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] directory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=5][b]🇰🇷 한국어 안내[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]개요[/b]: 바닐라에서 모자를 쓸 수 없던 배우자 및 마을 주민 전체에게 모자를 착용시키고, 인게임 전용 사이드 패널에서 실시간으로 위치(오프셋)를 조정할 수 있는 편의 모드입니다.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]사용 방법[/b]: NPC 근처(1.5타일 이내)에서 [b]H[/b]키를 누르면 모자 보관함과 우측 튜닝 사이드 패널이 열립니다.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]실시간 오프셋 조정[/b]:
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]적용 대상 (개별 / 공통)[/b]: 현재 수정을 해당 주민 1명 전용으로 저장할지, 같은 체형 범주(아동/여성/남성) 전체에 일괄 적용할지 전환 가능합니다.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]4방향 탭 ([아래] [위] [오른쪽] [왼쪽])[/b]: 비대칭 스프라이트를 고려해 좌/우가 분리되어 있으며, 탭 클릭 시 NPC가 해당 방향을 즉시 바라봅니다.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]회전 버튼[/b]: 메뉴를 닫지 않고 제자리에서 90도씩 회전시켜 4방향 핏을 바로 확인합니다.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]위치 조정 버튼[/b]: [-5], [-1], [+1], [+5] 버튼으로 모자 위치를 실시간 이동시킵니다.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]초기화 버튼[/b]: 개별 설정 삭제 후 공통 기본값으로 복귀합니다.[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]안전성[/b]: 하모니(Harmony) 패치를 일절 사용하지 않고 SMAPI 렌더링 및 바닐라 데이터 저장소만 활용하므로 충돌 및 세이브 손상 위험이 없습니다.[/color][/*]
[/list]
